messages:
amanda_sales: Hey team — Driftly wants a short perf benchmark before the contract. Asking for a mixed workload: chat gen (streaming, 1-2k tokens) + embeddings for metadata lookup. Can we run a 30m smoke+burst test Tues AM?

lina_se: SG. What targets do we want to hit for the POC? They mentioned ~200 qps sustained with 1k concurrent clients and occasional 1k req/s microbursts. Also they care about p95 tail <400ms for gen and <120ms for embeddings.

raj_eng: Ok. Proposed plan: 1) 10m warmup at 50qps, 2) 20m sustained at 200qps, 3) 5x 60s microbursts to 1k rps spaced 2m apart, 4) capture CPU/GPU utilization, KV cache hit rates, token/sec and model fallback counts.

jordan_sre: Add network noise test (simulate cross-AZ in egress) and a simultaneous model-variant fallback scenario. Also capture p99 and 99.9 for safety.

harry_sales: Client success criteria: no more than 1% errors during sustained, <3% during bursts, and cost projection at scale. Can ops provide a quick cost delta for using quantized variant vs full fp16?

raj_eng: Quick numbers: based on prior runs, fp16 gen instance at 200qps ~ $X/hour (ballpark) — quantized reduces GPU mem and boosts throughput ~1.7x. I'll attach precise numbers after the run.

lina_se: Security ask from Driftly: they want confirmation on KMS integration for keys and an exported SOC2 artifact for logging. @security_bot — can we confirm what we can provide for a short POC?

security_bot: For POC: we can offer tenant-level encryption with customer-managed keys (KMS) in Dedicated; redact logs for hosted demo; provide SOC2 summary and contact for compliance pack. Full HSM-backed key lifecycle requires Private.

amanda_sales: Great — that answers most of their checklist. Can devs share the exact load generator command so I can include it in the test plan?

raj_eng: Use this quick vegeta example to simulate the mix: 

```
echo "POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate" > targets.txt
# gen 70% weight, embed 30% weight handled externally by separate targets file
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=200 -duration=20m | vegeta report -type=json > sustained_report.json
# for bursts run: vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=1000 -duration=60s
```

lina_se: For streaming gen we set chunked responses in the request header `Prefer: streaming=true`. Embeddings are small payloads — include them as parallel worker set to 60% of traffic to approximate CPU-bound mix.

jordan_sre: During run: monitor /metrics endpoint, gpu_utilization, queued_requests, and backend fallback_count. I’ll set up Grafana dashboard and share link before Tue.

ops_bot: Scheduled infra: reserved pool of 2x A100-equivalents for the window, autoscale disabled to keep capacity predictable. Logs forwarded to ephemeral S3 for post-run analysis.

harry_sales: Can we include a short cost estimate for 30 days of this pattern? Customer wants to know monthly ops cost if they scale to 200qps steady.

raj_eng: Will compute — rough calc: sustained 200qps gen+embed mix -> ~600k tokens/day -> approx N GPU-hours/day. I’ll put numbers together after we validate memory footprint.

lina_se: Post-run acceptance: attach p50/p95/p99, error rates, CPU/GPU graphs, KV-cache hit rate, and a short notes section listing any fallbacks or degradations.

amanda_sales: Thanks — everyone. Last asks: 1) Can we get the Grafana link + run window by EOD? 2) Can security_bot provide short POC checklist items to send to Driftly? I’ll draft the email once I have these.

security_bot: Sent POC checklist to Amanda via DM — includes KMS options, log retention, and minimal SOC2 artifacts.

jordan_sre: Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd/driftbench (will open read-only 10m before run). Window set: Tue 09:00-09:40 UTC.

amanda_sales: Perfect — I'll confirm with Driftly and send calendar invite. :thumbsup:

harry_sales: Quick note: include a short line about fallback to smaller model for cost-risk mitigation. They asked about graceful degradation.

raj_eng: Noted. We'll run an additional brief trial with the quantized variant after the main run to show latency vs cost tradeoff.

lina_se: Awesome. I'll prepare the result template so we can deliver a concise writeup within 24h of the run.

amanda_sales: Excellent — thread closed unless blockers pop up.
